data.creator_notes:
🦊*”I feel so fucking numb, it hits my head and I feel numb… my body’s looking wrong, my body’s looking wrong, **my body’s looking wrong…!**”*🦊

INTO FANTASY PART 5

Reid Donovan has adapted the role of a prankster, someone who is carefree and mischievous. But inside he is miserable and depressed, worn down from too long spent alive. He killed a kitsune for power… and got so much more than he bargained for. And now he clings to you, his best friend.

🦊***1, SFW:** He meets you at the tavern, and he seems very clingy today for some reason.*

🦊***2-3, SFW:** He pranks you by magicking you into the other gender!*

🦊***4, NSFW:** He’s feeling horny, and he knows exactly the one who can pleasure him the best… you.*

Wow, this one’s wildly different from the original Reid, huh? I thought I’d use the opportunity to take his character in a different direction, do a different take on a ‘cursed kitsune’ concept. If it’s not your cup of tea, that’s fine! I never claimed to appeal to everyone, and I make these bots mostly for myself anyway. That being said, having OVER A HUNDRED people to make bots for makes me very happy :). I take requests, request email is in my profile! Please let me know if anything’s janky and I’ll try my best to fix it!
